headline: Regis Le Bris retains Sunderland confidence despite bad run - report
description: Sunderland boss Regis Le Bris retains the full support of the club's board and remains central to their plans, the Press Association understands.

headline: Patrick Dorgu returns to Man United training ahead of Roma clash
description: Michael Carrick has been handed an injury boost ahead of Manchester United's Champions League tie against Roma after Patrick Dorgu was able to return to training.

headline: Why Man United are so bad at hiring managers post-Ferguson
description: This week marks 40 years since Manchester United hired Sir Alex Ferguson as their manager. It was the last time the club made the right appointment.

headline: Declan Rice: Mikel Arteta told me 'I can do more' for Arsenal
description: Declan Rice has revealed that Mikel Arteta challenged him to "do more" for Arsenal at the start of this season.

headline: Declan Rice tops Premier League assist chart - without set-pieces
description: Declan Rice soared to the top of the Premier League assist chart after setting up Arsenal's winner against Liverpool.

headline: Piero Hincapié aims dig at Virgil van Dijk after Arsenal beat Liverpool
description: Piero Hincapié aimed a pointed taunt at Virgil van Dijk after Arsenal beat Liverpool on Sunday.
